issues.description: The script sends location data to Discord via GM_xmlhttpRequest, which may include user-coordinated map pins or game data. This is a third-party server and may be used for tracking or data collection.
issues.location: sendToDiscord function (implied by description and GM_xmlhttpRequest usage)
issues.recommendation: Warn users and make data transmission opt-in. Allow users to review and edit data before sending. Document exactly what is sent.

issues.description: The script sends latitude and longitude to nominatim.openstreetmap.org for reverse geocoding. While this is a public geocoding API, it still transmits user location data to a third party.
issues.recommendation: Inform users about this data transmission. Consider caching or minimizing requests.

issues.description: The script requests Notification API permission and can send notifications to the user.
issues.recommendation: Ensure notifications are not abused. Only use for legitimate user actions.

issues.description: The script modifies iframe sandbox attributes and disables anti-cheat scripts, which may weaken frame protections.
issues.recommendation: Avoid interfering with security features unless strictly necessary.

details: Reads and stores user hotkeys and feature toggles via GM_setValue/GM_getValue.
Sends user-selected map coordinates to third-party APIs.

script_name: GeoGuessr OpenGuessr WorldGuessr FreeGuessr Helper Universal
summary: This script transmits user location data to third-party servers (discord.com and nominatim.openstreetmap.org) via GM_xmlhttpRequest, which is a critical privacy and data exfiltration risk. It also requests Notification API permissions and modifies iframe protections, but does not appear to contain code obfuscation, DOM XSS, or supply chain risks. The main concern is the transmission of sensitive user data to external servers, which may be used for tracking or logging without explicit user consent.
